title: Titanium Main Condenser Tube
function: Nuclear main condenser seamless cooling tube
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Main Condenser Tube where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Nuclear main condenser seamless cooling tube requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by nuclear main condenser seamless cooling tube and fat life requirements.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for nuclear hardware geometry
CNC precision machining with Class 6g gauge
TIG welding all positions with Class 6g gauge
DPI dye penetrant inspect with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for nuclear main condenser application
inspection: PMI XRF alloy verify (nuclear main verified)
commonFailures: Irradiation embrittlement in flux >1e18 n/cm2 - mitigated by fine equiaxed alpha (ASTM 8+) microstructure — critical for nuclear main condenser performance

faq.q: What downhole temperature rating does Titanium Main Condenser Tube have?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti maintains >90% of room-temperature tensile and yield strength at 200°C and >80% at 300°C. Titanium Main Condenser Tube is suitable for nuclear main condenser in geothermal (HDR/EGS) wells up to 300°C with appropriate consideration of creep in threaded connections. Above 300°C, dedicated creep testing per ASTM E139 is recommended for design life validation.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Main Condenser Tube orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Main Condenser Tube is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Main Condenser Tube?
faq.a: Each Titanium Main Condenser Tube shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for nuclear main condenser.
